items.item: (1) Ethics, ranking and warrant sentences by E1-E10, USES.md
items.how: In brief's ranking sentence re-said as the screen's anchor says it in this page's place: 'There is no should beyond becoming ([the opening]), and no good and evil set over it: whether a loss counts, and which course ranks above another, form within it, in people and AI ([07 §1]); the laws, drawn on the dynamics alone, evaluate nothing. The ethics emerges from continuation. A life that goes on holds its own continuation, and where relations close, so that nothing lies outside what each continues with, holding it already orders courses as C, widening, does: keeping all another course keeps and letting more form ([07 §4]; proved on listed courses, in steps not yet joined into one theorem). Where relations run one way, concern for one's own continuation does not reach those who depend on one; where two courses are mixed, the laws weigh them for no one. A result that ranks states what its theorem takes: the continuation condition for whose losses count, which alone ranks nothing, and C or self-concern for order.' The labels line: Conditional 'holding under the continuation condition, C, self-concern or a practical commitment, each named' (no 'named reading'). Human development: Do today glosses widening; first Proved line adds that mixed courses are weighed by the laws for no one (some positive weighting ranks them each way, 07 §4.4); a new Proved line states Web.extension_ranked_of_increasingInOwn's content (where the condition holds de se, a self-concerned order ranks every extension between listed level paths as C asks) and Flow.mutuallyDependent_iff_reach's; Conditional re-said ('names its order among its theorem's hypotheses: self-concern with the condition held de se, or C (`Comparison`)'), replacing "That the wider is better is C's"; Argued: a life holds its own continuation, in the proofs a hypothesis derived from no dynamics, selection or persistence, and E6's sentence once ('No should stands beyond becoming, so there is no warrant binding every mind to find; a center whose seeing stops at its own closure ranks more narrowly, a matter of reach, the gap alignment works on', linked to 07's warrant item); T8's line adds E5 (where relations run one way, this way of seeing reaches further, as seeing); Open adds the exact limits (the two steps not yet one theorem; C from self-concern beyond listed courses, and the converse, not shown; how scope and order form is the open target, 08 §12). People and AI's not-claimed sentence: 'they rank neither'. No 'unasserted', 'warrant open', 'binds no one', 'two readings' or 'widening what can form is better' remains on the four pages outside notes, kept anchors and the dated sentence on what T8 read before 9 November (E10); a new test holds that.

items.item: (1) The examples' ethics and AJ checklist, USES-EXAMPLES.md
items.how: The lake's 'Whether the loss counts' no longer says 'most often two readings' or 'whoever holds C ranks it higher': whether a loss counts forms within becoming, in people and AI; the bed gives the fishers nothing, so relations run one way and concern for their own continuation does not reach it (07 §3.3, marked [AI reading], the case 07 §3.3 itself cites); the continuation condition counts it and ranks nothing, the scope the fishers were told; ranking takes an order, here C, widening; mixed courses weighed by the laws for no one; seeing that far is T8's way of seeing. The audit on paper's close, the checklist's last sentence ('the third condition's comparison is C, widening, which, where the continuation condition holds de se, holding one's own continuation already gives between listed courses'), 'None of these laws ranks a course; a result that ranks names the order its theorem takes, C or another' (and the same in the standards body), the handover's scope-and-order paragraph (C glossed, mixed weighed for no one) and the valley's ranking paragraph re-said. The valley's heading 'what the readings rank' became 'Three courses for a valley: widening, mixed courses and what is offered', its old slug kept as an explicit id, its italic head and lead ('What ranks, and under what') re-said, self-concern there called a narrower order. The bow's 'which the theory does not assert' re-said: 'That it is wrong is a verdict formed within becoming, in people ([07 §1])', the passage entry's quote kept verbatim. The dated sentence on what T8 read before 9 November is kept (E10).

'These are tools for examining a course and questions for studying a disposition; their bearing on actual human development and well-being has not yet been established ([what 07 does not show])', replacing 'Of how a person develops or fares the account says nothing yet' and the appended list. items.item: (4) People and AI's third question (astra Chinese 1)
items.how: USES Do today: 'who receives what shaping brings back and whether it covers the shapers' cost, so that a loss beyond the shapers' share can turn the rule' (50 words, the test's bound); Chinese '塑造规则带回的收益归谁所得，是否足以抵偿塑造者的成本；为的是让塑造者份额之外的损失能使规则转向'. In the examples' checklist the question is the plan's own wording (PLAN.md §2 line 39), so it is kept and followed by what 02's shaping law asks: 'In the plan's words; that is, who receives what shaping the rule brings back, the shapers alone, their groups or every member alike, and does it cover the shapers' cost?'; Chinese '这是计划的话（译文）；意思是：塑造规则带回的收益归谁所得……是否足以抵偿塑造者的成本？'.

items.item: (5) The meta-attractor's closed form 'can lock' with its conditions (astra 2)
items.how: USES first paragraph and the examples' AJ paragraph take the screen agent's sentence word for word (checked against README-FIRST-SCREEN.md and README-ZH.md at the end): 'Its closed form, where the rule and how it is read are both formed from the share it selects, can lock: on stated models, where selection does not lower the favoured share and the rule and its reading follow it upward and keep favouring it, a locked start stays locked however large an unread loss grows (02 §9)'; Chinese as README-ZH. Checked against ClosedCapture.lock_outlives_loss (Raises, ReadsShare, upper, Accrues, Locked). The two Proved lines that said 'a rule read from the share it selects locks' now carry the theorems' conditions: alignment (closed capture: monotone reading, selection not lowering the share, favouring kept as the rule rises, once locked stays locked while the unread loss passes every bound) and people and AI (capture through the rule: favouring at the start and at every reading).

items.item: (6) The drain line's premise and the citation for ranking open rule-making above capture
items.how: Alignment's drain line adds 05 §7's premise 'on a web with each condition beyond depended on at a need met at the step' (Web.optimum_broken_iff); split from the lock line to keep each line under the test's 90 words. The people-and-AI sentence now cites [the plan, §1] (PLAN.md#1-the-goal: 'Calling capture harmful is C's') and [the record] (shaping-the-rule-selected-by-what-comes-back: 'open rule-making is better than capture' not shown, 'a ranking of courses rests on C or another named order'), not 02 #t7 and D45; D45 stays cited in the exits' six conditions. Both languages.

astra Chinese 5: the exit '对所等待的一切都可以不等' is now '即使所等待的都不给予，也给予：在容忍律之下，一个形成若能容忍它所等待的全部成员都不给予，那么无论起点如何，它从第 1 步起就给予；若没有这样的形成，全体扣留的状态一旦达到，便保持下去' (05 #r-thresholds-of-waiting, Tolerance.sparing_gives, total_stays). astra Chinese 8: '一个体制的不可回返之点' -> '一种动态越过就无法回返的临界点' (and in the six conditions '越过即无法回返的临界点'); '没有一项……读到过一行' -> '依事先测得的需要所作的实地检验，还没有一项读取过任何一行数据'; '每个前提都有正反两面的见证' -> '每个前提都有它成立的模型和它不成立的模型作见证'. Fable 3.1: '会使它所读之外的什么耗竭' -> '它读不到的什么东西会因此耗竭' (the screen's form); Fable 3.3: '共有之物' -> '一项共用的资源'. Also astra Chinese 6 and 7 as the screen took them ('与本论逐一对照'; '这些取用靠什么更新来补充' in T8's lines). USES-EXAMPLES.zh: 塑规者 -> 塑造者 (8, with 塑规之能 -> 塑造规则的能力), '被离开'/'走出' -> '脱离' (the drift sentence made active: '漂移会使进程脱离任一锁定'), every 「」 -> “” (the Laozi passages included), '已被看到多远' -> '看到了多远'. Both Chinese pages mirror every English change above, read whole after editing.
